function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I don’t have direct access to a live clock, so I can’t tell you the precise moment “right now” in New York.  
If you’d like help converting a particular UTC/ISO timestamp into New York time—or just want to double‑check how many hours ahead/behind you’re off—just drop the time here and I’ll do the conversion for you.

As of May 18, 2026, New York would likely be Eastern Daylight Time (UTC-04). So if current UTC time is unknown, can't give exact. Could respond with explanation.

We could ask clarifying question about whether they need an estimate relative to their own time. Or we might use system knowledge: It's currently around some hour. But as AI offline, cannot fetch live time. Should explain limitation.
